notes: Product is a two-piece USB VGA KVM console extender: one Local unit (at the console/user side) and one Remote unit (at the computer side); each physical unit is identical in port layout and is listed once here (duplicate the port set per unit if modeling both halves separately). The "CPU Port" is a proprietary SPHD-17 combo connector carrying VGA + 2x USB-A signaling to the host PC via IOGEAR's included custom KVM cable — modeled here as connector "vga" with accepts:["usb-a"] since SPHD-17 is not in the allowed connector list and VGA is the closest physical/signal match. No bandwidth grade applies to any port (VGA and USB here are legacy/unspecified-version and RJ45 carries only KVM extension traffic, not a graded Ethernet data rate, per manufacturer docs). Power: external adapter, DC 5.3V/0.94A, barrel/DC-jack connector, one per unit (two adapters included in box). Not rack-mountable as a standard 19in rack unit height (each unit is ~1in x 5in x 3.375in desktop/mountable-bracket form factor); omitted rackUnits. Sources cross-checked: IOGEAR official support/spec page (support.iogear.com/product/GCE500U) and manufacturer installation manual (front/rear panel descriptions) at manualslib.com, plus manufacturer datasheet PDF hosted on Farnell confirming DC 5.3V power spec.
